title: Multibody Dynamics Simulator — Overview and definition
t: Multibody Dynamics Simulator — Overview and definition
description: Simulates rigid and flexible bodies with joints, contacts, and forces in time domain.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Simulates rigid and flexible bodies with joints, contacts, and forces in time domain. A multibody dynamics simulator integrates the equations of motion for systems of interconnected bodies under gravity, actuators, springs, dampers, and contact forces. Real implementations use recursive O(n) formulations or maximal-coordinate DAE integration with Baumgarte stabilization, plus penalty or impulse-based contact. Public examples include PyDy, Project Chrono, and the dynamics cores inside Adams and RecurDyn.

body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. How Multibody Dynamics Simulator is actually implemented. A multibody dynamics simulator integrates the equations of motion for systems of interconnected bodies under gravity, actuators, springs, dampers, and contact forces. Real implementations combine Python/C++ API, GUI model builder, FMI co-simulation interface with A DAE/ODE integrator (SUNDIALS), a collision library, Eigen.
